title: 第9章 胜负已分第10章 救治未及
content_zh:
楚无忌目光不动，只盯着台上两人。
韩青符箓甩得飞快，却衔接略乱；赵石后退似怯，但步伐丝毫不乱。
果然，枪修赵石忽然咬牙，一踏台面，枪尖一挑，借势突进。
韩青慌忙再掷符，却慢了一线，被枪杆横扫在胸口，当场喷出一口血，翻滚出去，撞在防护光幕上，光幕荡出涟漪，他才跌坐在地，脸色惨白。
韩青胸口起伏剧烈，抬手想喊认输，却张口喷出一道鲜血，连声音都吐不出来。
台下哄声四起。
台下有人起哄：“继续补刀！别留手！”
楚无忌眉头一皱，旋即扬声高喝：“胜负已分！”
赵石眼里凶光一闪，竟还想补一枪。
楚无忌脚尖一点，催动小风遁术，身形如风掠入台上。
他只抬手一拦，右手法力一吐，赵石枪尖便偏了半寸，擦着韩青的肩头划过，只割开衣袍，未伤筋骨。
赵石猛地回头，正对上楚无忌微微眯起的双眼，寒光逼人。
赵石虽见楚无忌年龄尚幼，但修为比自己练气六层要高，当即强压火气抱拳：“执事师兄见谅，方才专心斗法，未曾听见宣判。”
楚无忌淡淡嗯了一声，转身扶起跌坐弟子，从储物袋中取出宗门配发的止血散，按在他胸口伤处。
“别乱运功。”他压低声音，“收住气息，先护心脉。”
韩青唇色发白，仍止不住颤抖，手却死死攥住楚无忌的袖角，急促地含糊道：“多谢……小师兄……”
楚无忌将人交给兼职医修的曹懿，这才回到原位。
他脸上不露分毫，心里却更沉了一分。
第一场尚且如此，后面斗法厮杀只会更凶。
打的这么凶，搞不好后面真的要被倒扣贡献点就抓马了。

宗门大比，外门弟子拼命想进内门，斗法前百名甚至不必满足练气后期修为要求，便可破格入内门；内门弟子则想争真传。每一个名额背后，都是成百上千的贡献点、灵石、灵丹。
利益面前，谁肯轻易退让半步？
......
第二天、第三天，斗法台上的血腥味越发浓了。
有人被雷符轰得半边身子焦黑，痛得在地上打滚，嘶哑地喊：“我认输！我认......”
话没说完，对手仍强撑着想要再补一道雷符。
楚无忌小风遁术一闪，硬生生抢在第二道雷符激活前将人救下斗法台。
台下却还在起哄：“再来一下！他还能动！”
楚无忌抬眼扫过人群，那些叫喊声立刻低了几分。
又有人被飞剑贯穿大腿，鲜血淌了一地，斗法台台面都被染得发暗；有人被毒雾侵入经脉，脸色青紫，眼珠外凸，若不是及时拖出来，恐怕当场便要断气。
更有甚者，两名弟子斗到最后法力同时见底，竟直接用凡俗武学扭打在一起，牙齿咬在对方耳朵上，生生撕下一块肉。
台下看得兴奋，叫好声不断，仿佛就是要看血流成河。
楚无忌救人救到手都麻了。
content_en:
Chu Wuji kept his eyes fixed, only staring at the two people on the stage.
Han Qing swung the talisman very fast, but the connection was slightly messy; Zhao Shi retreated as if timidly, but his steps were not messy at all.
Sure enough, gun master Zhao Shi suddenly gritted his teeth, stepped on the table, raised the tip of his spear, and took advantage of the situation to charge forward.
Han Qing hurriedly threw the talisman again, but he was too late and was swept across the chest by the gun barrel. He spurted out a mouthful of blood on the spot, rolled out, and hit the protective light curtain. The light curtain rippled, and he fell to the ground, his face pale.
Han Qing's chest rose and fell violently. He raised his hands and wanted to admit defeat, but a stream of blood spurted out from his mouth and he couldn't even spit out a sound.
There was a roar in the audience.
Some people in the audience cheered: "Keep hitting! Don't hold back!"
Chu Wuji frowned and immediately shouted loudly: "The winner has been decided!"
Zhao Shi's eyes flashed fiercely, and he actually wanted to take another shot.
Chu Wuji tiptoed, activated the Xiaofeng Escape Technique, and his body swept onto the stage like the wind.
He just raised his hand to stop, and spat out the magic power from his right hand. The tip of Zhao Shi's spear was deflected by half an inch, grazing Han Qing's shoulder, only cutting open his robe without damaging his muscles and bones.
Zhao Shi turned around suddenly and met Chu Wuji's slightly narrowed eyes, which were filled with cold light.
Although Zhao Shi saw that Chu Wuji was still young, but his cultivation level was higher than his own at the sixth level of Qi training, he immediately suppressed his anger and clasped his fists: "I'm sorry, Brother Deacon, I was just concentrating on the fight and didn't hear the verdict."
Chu Wuji gave a faint hum, turned around, helped the fallen disciple up, took out the sect-issued hemostasis powder from the storage bag, and pressed it on the injured area on his chest.
"Don't mess around with your luck." He lowered his voice, "Control your breath and protect your heart first."
Han Qing's lips turned white and she still couldn't stop trembling, but her hands tightly grasped Chu Wuji's sleeves and said hurriedly and vaguely: "Thank you... little senior brother..."
Chu Wuji handed him over to Cao Yi, a part-time medical practitioner, and then returned to his original position.
He didn't show anything on his face, but his heart became even heavier.
If this is the case in the first game, the subsequent battles will only become more fierce.
If you fight so fiercely, you might really end up having your contribution points deducted later and you'll be caught.
In the sect competition, the outer sect disciples desperately want to enter the inner sect. The top 100 in the battle can even enter the inner sect without meeting the requirements for the later stage of Qi training. The inner sect disciples want to compete for the true inheritance. Behind every quota are hundreds of contribution points, spiritual stones, and spiritual elixirs.
In the face of interests, who is willing to give in even half a step?
...
On the second and third days, the smell of blood on the fighting stage became stronger.
Someone was hit by the thunder talisman and half of his body was scorched black. He was rolling on the ground in pain and shouted hoarsely: "I admit defeat! I admit..."
Before he finished speaking, his opponent was still holding on and wanted to add another thunder talisman.
Chu Wuji used his Xiaofeng Escape Technique to dodge and rescue the person from the fighting platform before the second thunder talisman was activated.
But the audience was still cheering: "Do it again! He can still move!"
Chu Wuji raised his eyes and scanned the crowd, and the shouts immediately became a little lower.
Another person was penetrated by a flying sword in the thigh, and blood flowed all over the floor, and the surface of the fighting platform was dyed dark; someone was invaded by the poisonous mist, his meridians, his face was purple, and his eyes were bulging. If he hadn't been dragged out in time, he might have died on the spot.
What's more, the two disciples fought until their magic power was exhausted at the same time, and they actually used ordinary martial arts to fight each other, biting each other's ears with their teeth, and tearing off a piece of flesh.
The audience was excited and cheered constantly, as if they just wanted to see blood flowing like a river.
Chu Wuji's hands were numb even after saving people.
